responsibility: Declares the ExternCrate reader used by Rust metadata import code to decode one external crate record from an Import::Stream. The class owns the parsed crate name and metadata payload, provides status and accessors for the decoded result, and exposes the load routine and integer-parsing helper used to validate the serialized header fields of imported metadata.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ExternCrate metadata-reader class, its accessors, load entry point, and integer-parsing helper signature for use by import code. Unlike the .cc implementation, it does not parse stream bytes itself; it exposes the reader’s API and stored result fields.
